name: MITRE D3FEND 1.6.0
description: MITRE D3FEND 1.6.0 (released 2026-08-31), a knowledge graph of cybersecurity countermeasures (https://d3fend.mitre.org/), funded by the NSA Cybersecurity Directorate and managed by MITRE. D3FEND relates the defensive techniques that counter cyber attacks, and the tactics they serve, to the digital artifacts they analyze, harden, isolate, deceive with, evict or restore, and to the offensive techniques of MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS and SPARTA that act on the same artifacts; it maps them to CWE weaknesses, NIST SP 800-53 and DISA CCI controls, ATT&CK mitigations and the references that ground them. D3FEND's classes are the content of the knowledge graph, so each becomes a node, labelled by its category, e.g. DefensiveTechnique or DigitalArtifact, and also D3FENDClass. Its references, controls and catalogs, which D3FEND holds as individuals, are nodes too. Each D3FEND relation, asserted or stated by a restriction, is a relationship between the categories it links, and rdfs:subClassOf is SUBCLASS_OF. Generated from the D3FEND Turtle file.

D3FENDClass.description: A class of the D3FEND knowledge base: a defensive or offensive tactic or technique, a digital or physical artifact, an event, a weakness or any other concept D3FEND defines. Every node that stands for a D3FEND class carries this label, 4446 in D3FEND 1.6.0; the label of its category, e.g. DefensiveTechnique, says what kind of class it is. Classes in no category, e.g. Vulnerability or Capability, carry this label alone.
